backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that manages quote requests with functions to submit, retrieve by ID, search by name, and get all requests stored in a Map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three completed features: removing 'crack'/'cracks' references, adding affordability tagline, and updating 'pool' to 'pool decks' in frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, and configuration with details about recent content updates and styling changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a concrete-inspired design palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the NewGate Concrete Coating application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles the full page layout with Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, and Footer components.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Component displaying company benefits with icons, service areas (Orlando, Tampa, Plant City) with MapPin badges, and value proposition content about polyaspartic coating expertise.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with validation that submits quote requests to the backend actor, includes service type dropdown, phone/email display, and success state handling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company info, social media links, quick navigation, contact details, service areas list, and caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component displaying the main landing area with background image, company name, service description, phone number CTA, and buttons to scroll to contact and services sections.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Navigation bar component with logo, desktop/mobile menu, scroll-based styling changes, and smooth scrolling to page sections (Home, Services, About, Contact).
Services section displaying four polyaspartic coating service cards (Patio, Driveway, Pool Deck, Garage) with images, descriptions, and feature tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all quote requests and submitting new quote requests via the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom concrete-inspired color palette (copper accents, warm grays), dark mode support, and utility classes for the coating company theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space (including copper, concrete, sidebar themes), extended typography, container queries, animations, and custom border radius/shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting NewGate Concrete Coating website features including hero section, services showcase (patio/driveway/pool/garage coating), about section, contact form, navigation, industrial-modern design theme, and company branding elements.
